title: Ep 25 — Anthropic pledges more compute to Cursor as music publishers sue over training data, and the weekend Amazon tool now clearing thirty thousand dollars a month
description: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over how Claude was trained, an infostealer campaign is hijacking live Claude login sessions without needing a password, and Anthropic's Chief Compute Officer publicly pledges more capacity to Cursor within hours of OpenAI's move to cut it off. Plus a deep dive on Launch Fast, Hasaam Bhatti's forty-eight-hour weekend build that reached thirty thousand dollars a month in Amazon seller-research revenue within ninety days, and why the DCMS National Lottery consultation and the still-unclaimed sports-venue EV-charging gap both remain live threads for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.
